name: EX-09 NATO Integration Exercise — 5 Days
description: Full-week NATO-style multinational integration exercise, around-the-clock (D1–D4) with working-hours wrap-up on D5. Demonstrates the complexity of coalition coordination, liaison officer management, and multi-phase operations. Uses LOGREP reporting alongside SITREPs. Good reference for large, complex exercises requiring sustained operations planning.

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: 5-day NATO exercise begins. All national contingents confirmed at their assigned positions. Coalition HQ activated.

items.title: Nations Representatives Brief
items.description: Exercise director briefs all national contingent commanders. Coalition HQ structure, communication plan, exercise objectives.

items.title: Force Laydown Confirmation
items.description: Each national contingent confirms their force laydown on the Coalition COP. Interoperability checks completed.

items.title: Coalition Orders Group
items.description: Full coalition orders. Phase 1 tasks to all national contingents. Liaison officer assignments confirmed.

items.title: Intel: Coalition Assessment D1
items.description: Coalition intelligence assessment. Fused intelligence from all national contributions. Common threat picture.

items.title: LOGREP 1 — Logistics Status
items.description: First logistics report from all contingents. Supply status, fuel, ammunition, medical capacity.

items.title: Phase 1 Initiating Directive
items.description: Coalition HQ issues the Phase 1 initiating directive to all contingents via secure communications.

items.title: Coalition Standup D1
items.description: Daily coalition standup. Quick status from each national contingent: green/amber/red status.

items.title: Phase 1 Main Operations D1
items.description: Phase 1 multinational operations. Contingents execute assigned tasks, coordinate via coalition comms.

items.title: SITREP 1800 D1
items.description: Evening D1 coalition SITREP. All contingents report. Summary for coalition commander.

items.title: Night Operations Phase 1 D1
items.description: Night operations. Coalition HQ maintains watch. Contingents continue Phase 1 tasks.

items.title: SITREP 0200 D2
items.description: Night coalition SITREP from watch officers.

items.title: Coalition Standup D2
items.description: D2 morning standup. Overnight summary. Day priorities.

items.title: Phase 1 Operations D2
items.description: D2 Phase 1 continuation. Increasing coordination complexity as Phase 2 approaches.

items.title: LOGREP 2 — Mid-Exercise Log
items.description: Second logistics report. Identify resupply requirements for Phase 2.

items.title: Decision Point Alpha — Phase 2 Gateway
items.description: Coalition commander decides to proceed to Phase 2. All contingent commanders confirm readiness.

items.title: SITREP 1800 D2
items.description: Evening D2 SITREP. Phase 1 close-out status.

items.title: Phase 1 Night Ops D2
items.description: D2 night operations. Transition preparations for Phase 2.

items.title: SITREP 0400 D3
items.description: Pre-dawn D3 report. Readiness for Phase 2 transition.

items.title: Phase 2 Initiating
items.description: Phase 2 begins. Increased operational tempo. All national contingents transition to Phase 2 tasks.

items.title: Phase 2 Orders Group
items.description: Full coalition Phase 2 orders. New tasks, coordination measures, fire support plan.

items.title: Coalition Intelligence Fusion
items.description: All national intelligence cells fuse their collection into a common picture for the coalition commander.

items.title: LOGREP 3 — Phase 2 Log
items.description: Phase 2 logistics report. Critical supplies identified. Emergency resupply requests.

items.title: Phase 2 Main Activity
items.description: Phase 2 core operations. Multi-domain coordination: ground, air, cyber, information.

items.title: Decision Point Bravo — Phase 3 Gateway
items.description: Coalition commander decision: conditions for Phase 3 met? All contingents must be above 70% effective strength.

items.title: SITREP 1800 D3
items.description: Evening D3 coalition SITREP.

items.title: Night Ops Phase 2 D3
items.description: D3 night operations. Phase 2 continuation.

items.title: SITREP 0400 D4
items.description: Pre-dawn D4 report. Phase 3 readiness.

items.title: Phase 3 Initiating
items.description: Phase 3 begins — Exploitation. All coalition elements advance on assigned axes.

items.title: Phase 3 Orders Group
items.description: Phase 3 coalition orders. Final objectives, decision points, end state conditions.

items.title: Exploitation Operations D4
items.description: Exploitation phase. All national contingents execute Phase 3 tasks.

items.title: LOGREP 4 — Final Log
items.description: Final logistics report. End-state log status for all contingents.

items.title: Decision Point Charlie — End State
items.description: Coalition commander confirms exercise end state achieved. All Phase 3 objectives met.

items.title: SITREP 1800 D4
items.description: Evening D4 SITREP. Phase 3 status.

items.title: Night Ops D4
items.description: D4 night. Final operations and consolidation. AAR preparation begins.

items.title: SITREP 0400 D5
items.description: Pre-dawn D5 report. All contingents confirm Phase 3 complete.

items.title: D5 Morning Brief
items.description: Day 5 morning brief. Exercise overview, AAR schedule, national debrief timings.

items.title: Multinational AAR
items.description: Full coalition after action review. Each national contingent presents: strengths, weaknesses, interoperability issues, recommendations.

items.title: Physical: Closing Ceremony
items.description: Closing ceremony with all national representatives. Exercise commander's assessment delivered. Certificate of participation.

items.title: Final Exercise Report
items.description: Coalition exercise report submitted. Distributed to all national HQs within 48 hours.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: 5-day NATO integration exercise concluded. All national contingents released.
